gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-sono: Sono reads wide and loose, with tall lowercase and each a left slightly ajar, while Electroharmonix breaks its words into spaced-out letters above. The gap between display and text is the draw.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-stack-sans: Stack Sans Headline reads crisp even at tiny sizes, its monoline skeleton and deep middle band keeping every gap wide. Electroharmonix is the one for striking, split-letter display; this one is for steady text.

gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-tiktok-san: Gapped, commanding display letters up top, then TikTok Sans beneath with an x-height rising close to cap height. And if the text feels crowded, a slightly smaller heading would give that tall body room.

gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-yaldevi: Neutral, almost blank in tone, Yaldevi is the text face here. Its outsized lowercase and right-opening e give Electroharmonix's gapped, commanding letters a plain, readable partner to sit under.
